market_story: Storage: ERCOT batteries in 2023 priced scarce SOC at their experienced recent frequency of deep-scarcity events — the IMM's artificial-shortage summer monetized through adaptive expectation offers ($3.4-5k asks after August's spike experience, decaying to ~$300 by November as events vanished). The mechanism reproduces that conduct from the model's OWN price path (7/3/0 self-generated spike days across 2023/24/25; the 2025 floor is exactly zero — self-extinguishing), with two measured-conduct constants (30 d memory half-life, gain 3.0077) identified on the 2023 daily evening SCED offer surface and frozen. No measured price, no year key, no regime parameter enters the armed path. EVENT-REALIZED RELEASE (ercot-223): the holdout conduct is a claim about WHEN the fleet releases, not the social cost of its stored energy — on the real May-8-2024 storm evening (RT $2,451) the fleet discharged into the spike and no firm load was shed. At hours the model's own pass-1 path marks the anticipated spike as realized, the offer clears and the floor yields; everywhere else (99% of floored hours) the anticipation conduct stands. Without the guard, offer-as-cost debased the LP's private SOC value against the co-opt's floor-free reserve-headroom value and manufactured 17.9 MW of shed reality never recorded (ercot223_shed_phase0.json).
